human_review.finding: You can include both places where to secure the Tax Declaration of the Property. For the fencing permit fees, in accordance to national building code of the philippines (pd 1096): if it is made of masonry, metal, concrete and up to 1.80 meters in height, it is considered as a fence and the fee is based on the total length of the fence. If it is made of masonry, metal, concrete and above 1.80 meters in height, Php 3.00 per linear meter of fraction thereof. If more than 1.80 meters in height with the same made of materials, Php 4.00 per linear meter of fraction thereof. If it is made of indigenous materials, barbed, chicken or hog wire, regardless of height, Php 2.40 per linear meter
